sanskrit: i̱hendrā̱gnī upa̍ hvaye̱ tayo̱r it stoma̍m uśmasi | tā soma̍ṁ soma̱pāta̍mā ||
english: Here I invoke Indra and Agni together; it is their praise that we desire. Those two, who are the most avid drinkers of Soma, come drink the Soma.

sanskrit: tā ya̱jñeṣu̱ pra śa̍ṁsatendrā̱gnī śu̍mbhatā naraḥ | tā gā̍ya̱treṣu̍ gāyata ||
english: Praise those two, Indra and Agni, at the sacrifices; adorn them, O men. Sing of those two in the Gāyatrī metres.

sanskrit: tā mi̱trasya̱ praśa̍staya indrā̱gnī tā ha̍vāmahe | so̱ma̱pā soma̍pītaye ||
english: For the glory of Mitra, we invoke those two, Indra and Agni — those Soma-drinkers — to drink the Soma.

sanskrit: u̱grā santā̍ havāmaha̱ upe̱daṁ sava̍naṁ su̱tam | i̱ndrā̱gnī eha ga̍cchatām ||
english: We invoke the two mighty ones for this pressing where the Soma is expressed. Let Indra and Agni come hither.

sanskrit: tā ma̱hāntā̱ sada̱spatī̱ indrā̍gnī̱ rakṣa̍ ubjatam | apra̍jāḥ santv a̱triṇa̍ḥ ||
english: Those two great lords of the assembly, Indra and Agni, crush the demons. May those who devour without offspring remain childless.

sanskrit: tena̍ sa̱tyena̍ jāgṛta̱m adhi̍ prace̱tune̍ pa̱de | indrā̍gnī̱ śarma̍ yacchatam ||
english: By that truth, keep vigilant watch over the highly luminous station. Indra and Agni, grant us shelter.

sanskrit: prā̱ta̱ryujā̱ vi bo̍dhayā̱śvinā̱v eha ga̍cchatām | a̱sya soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: Arouse the two who yoke their chariot at dawn — let the Aśvins come hither to drink of this Soma.

sanskrit: yā su̱rathā̍ ra̱thīta̍mo̱bhā de̱vā di̍vi̱spṛśā̍ | a̱śvinā̱ tā ha̍vāmahe ||
english: Those two gods with the excellent chariot, the most chariot-skilled of all, touching heaven — those two Aśvins we invoke.

sanskrit: yā vā̱ṁ kaśā̱ madhu̍ma̱ty aśvi̍nā sū̱nṛtā̍vatī | tayā̍ ya̱jñam mi̍mikṣatam ||
english: That whip of yours, O Aśvins, honey-sweet and full of true, joyful speech — with it refresh the sacrifice.

sanskrit: na̱hi vā̱m asti̍ dūra̱ke yatrā̱ rathe̍na̱ gaccha̍thaḥ | aśvi̍nā so̱mino̍ gṛ̱ham ||
english: There is no far distance for you, wherever you go by chariot — O Aśvins, the Soma-presser's house is not remote to you.

sanskrit: hira̍ṇyapāṇim ū̱taye̍ savi̱tāra̱m upa̍ hvaye | sa cettā̍ de̱vatā̍ pa̱dam ||
english: For our aid I invoke golden-handed Savitar; he it is who points out the station of the gods.

sanskrit: a̱pāṁ napā̍ta̱m ava̍se savi̱tāra̱m upa̍ stuhi | tasya̍ vra̱tāny u̍śmasi ||
english: Praise Savitar, the child of the waters, for our protection; his ordinances we desire to follow.

sanskrit: vi̱bha̱ktāra̍ṁ havāmahe̱ vaso̍ś ci̱trasya̱ rādha̍saḥ | sa̱vi̱tāra̍ṁ nṛ̱cakṣa̍sam ||
english: We invoke the distributor of brilliant and various treasures, Savitar who looks upon all men.

sanskrit: sakhā̍ya̱ ā ni ṣī̍data savi̱tā stomyo̱ nu na̍ḥ | dātā̱ rādhā̍ṁsi śumbhati ||
english: Friends, be seated here — Savitar is now worthy of our praise; the giver adorns bountiful gifts.

sanskrit: agne̱ patnī̍r i̱hā va̍ha de̱vānā̍m uśa̱tīr upa̍ | tvaṣṭā̍ra̱ṁ soma̍pītaye ||
english: O Agni, bring hither the willing consorts of the gods, and Tvaṣṭṛ, to drink the Soma.

sanskrit: ā gnā a̍gna i̱hāva̍se̱ hotrā̍ṁ yaviṣṭha̱ bhāra̍tīm | varū̍trīṁ dhi̱ṣaṇā̍ṁ vaha ||
english: O youngest Agni, bring the divine wives hither for our protection — Hotrā, Bhāratī, Varūtrī, and Dhiṣaṇā.

sanskrit: a̱bhi no̍ de̱vīr ava̍sā ma̱haḥ śarma̍ṇā nṛ̱patnī̍ḥ | acchi̍nnapatrāḥ sacantām ||
english: May the divine wives of heroes, with their unbroken wings, accompany us with great shelter and protection.

sanskrit: i̱hendrā̱ṇīm upa̍ hvaye varuṇā̱nīṁ sva̱staye̍ | a̱gnāyī̱ṁ soma̍pītaye ||
english: Here I invoke Indrāṇī and Varuṇānī for well-being, and Agnāyī to drink the Soma.

sanskrit: ma̱hī dyauḥ pṛ̍thi̱vī ca̍ na i̱maṁ ya̱jñam mi̍mikṣatām | pi̱pṛ̱tāṁ no̱ bharī̍mabhiḥ ||
english: Let great Heaven and Earth refresh this our sacrifice; let them fill us with their nourishing powers.

sanskrit: tayo̱r id ghṛ̱tava̱t payo̱ viprā̍ rihanti dhī̱tibhi̍ḥ | ga̱ndha̱rvasya̍ dhru̱ve pa̱de ||
english: The inspired sages, with their thoughts, lick the ghee-rich milk of those two at the firm station of the Gandharva.

sanskrit: syo̱nā pṛ̍thivi bhavānṛkṣa̱rā ni̱veśa̍nī | yacchā̍ na̱ḥ śarma̍ sa̱pratha̍ḥ ||
english: Be gentle, O Earth, thornless and good for settling; grant us wide shelter.

sanskrit: ato̍ de̱vā a̍vantu no̱ yato̱ viṣṇu̍r vicakra̱me | pṛ̱thi̱vyāḥ sa̱pta dhāma̍bhiḥ ||
english: From that quarter whence Viṣṇu strode, through the seven stations of the earth, may the gods protect us.

sanskrit: i̱daṁ viṣṇu̱r vi ca̍krame tre̱dhā ni da̍dhe pa̱dam | samū̍ḻham asya pāṁsu̱re ||
english: Viṣṇu strode across this universe; three times he planted his step; it is gathered together in his dust-filled footprint.

sanskrit: trīṇi̍ pa̱dā vi ca̍krame̱ viṣṇu̍r go̱pā adā̍bhyaḥ | ato̱ dharmā̍ṇi dhā̱raya̍n ||
english: Viṣṇu, the undeceivable guardian, strode his three steps, upholding the cosmic laws from that foundation.

sanskrit: viṣṇo̱ḥ karmā̍ṇi paśyata̱ yato̍ vra̱tāni̍ paspa̱śe | indra̍sya̱ yujya̱ḥ sakhā̍ ||
english: Behold the deeds of Viṣṇu, from whom he set in motion his ordinances — the worthy ally and friend of Indra.

sanskrit: tad viṣṇo̍ḥ para̱mam pa̱daṁ sadā̍ paśyanti sū̱raya̍ḥ | di̱vī̍va̱ cakṣu̱r āta̍tam ||
english: That highest step of Viṣṇu the wise ones always behold, spread out like an eye in the sky.

sanskrit: tad viprā̍so vipa̱nyavo̍ jāgṛ̱vāṁsa̱ḥ sam i̍ndhate | viṣṇo̱r yat pa̍ra̱mam pa̱dam ||
english: The inspired and eloquent poets, ever wakeful, kindle together that highest step of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: tī̱vrāḥ somā̍sa̱ ā ga̍hy ā̱śīrva̍ntaḥ su̱tā i̱me | vāyo̱ tān prasthi̍tān piba ||
english: Come to the potent, mixed Soma juices, these that are pressed and ready. O Vāyu, drink of those that are set forth.

sanskrit: u̱bhā de̱vā di̍vi̱spṛśe̍ndravā̱yū ha̍vāmahe | a̱sya soma̍sya pī̱taye̍ ||
english: We invoke both gods who touch the sky, Indra and Vāyu, to drink of this Soma.

sanskrit: i̱ndra̱vā̱yū ma̍no̱juvā̱ viprā̍ havanta ū̱taye̍ | sa̱ha̱srā̱kṣā dhi̱yas patī̍ ||
english: The inspired poets invoke for protection Indra and Vāyu, swift as thought, the thousand-eyed lords of wisdom.

sanskrit: mi̱traṁ va̱yaṁ ha̍vāmahe̱ varu̍ṇa̱ṁ soma̍pītaye | ja̱jñā̱nā pū̱tada̍kṣasā ||
english: We invoke Mitra and Varuṇa to drink the Soma — the two born with pure discernment.

sanskrit: ṛ̱tena̱ yāv ṛ̍tā̱vṛdhā̍v ṛ̱tasya̱ jyoti̍ṣa̱s patī̍ | tā mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā huve ||
english: Those two who by ṛta increase ṛta, the lords of the light of ṛta — those two, Mitra and Varuṇa, I invoke.

sanskrit: varu̍ṇaḥ prāvi̱tā bhu̍van mi̱tro viśvā̍bhir ū̱tibhi̍ḥ | kara̍tāṁ naḥ su̱rādha̍saḥ ||
english: May Varuṇa be our promoter and Mitra with all his aids; may those two of excellent bounty act on our behalf.

sanskrit: ma̱rutva̍ntaṁ havāmaha̱ indra̱m ā soma̍pītaye | sa̱jūr ga̱ṇena̍ tṛmpatu ||
english: We invoke Indra, accompanied by the Maruts, to drink the Soma; let him be satisfied together with the host.

sanskrit: indra̍jyeṣṭhā̱ maru̍dgaṇā̱ devā̍sa̱ḥ pūṣa̍rātayaḥ | viśve̱ mama̍ śrutā̱ hava̍m ||
english: The troops of Maruts with Indra as chief, the gods who give gifts like Pūṣan — all of you, hear my call.

sanskrit: ha̱ta vṛ̱traṁ su̍dānava̱ indre̍ṇa̱ saha̍sā yu̱jā | mā no̍ du̱ḥśaṁsa̍ īśata ||
english: You generous ones, slay Vṛtra along with Indra your mighty ally; let no evil-speaker rule over us.

sanskrit: viśvā̍n de̱vān ha̍vāmahe ma̱ruta̱ḥ soma̍pītaye | u̱grā hi pṛśni̍mātaraḥ ||
english: We invoke all the gods, the Maruts, to drink the Soma — mighty they are, born of the dappled cow Pṛśni.

sanskrit: jaya̍tām iva tanya̱tur ma̱rutā̍m eti dhṛṣṇu̱yā | yac chubha̍ṁ yā̱thanā̍ naraḥ ||
english: Like the thunder of conquerors, the rumble of the Maruts advances boldly — whatever splendor you possess, O heroes, as you go.

sanskrit: ha̱skā̱rād vi̱dyuta̱s pary ato̍ jā̱tā a̍vantu naḥ | ma̱ruto̍ mṛḻayantu naḥ ||
english: Born from the ha-sound and the lightning flash, may they protect us from that. May the Maruts be gracious to us.

sanskrit: ā pū̍ṣañ ci̱traba̍rhiṣa̱m āghṛ̍ṇe dha̱ruṇa̍ṁ di̱vaḥ | ājā̍ na̱ṣṭaṁ yathā̍ pa̱śum ||
english: O shining Pūṣan, bring back the brilliant sacrificial seat, the pillar of heaven, as a goat-herd leads back a lost animal.

sanskrit: pū̱ṣā rājā̍na̱m āghṛ̍ṇi̱r apa̍gūḻha̱ṁ guhā̍ hi̱tam | avi̍ndac ci̱traba̍rhiṣam ||
english: The shining Pūṣan, the king, found the one hidden away, laid in a secret place — he found the one with the brilliant sacred grass.

sanskrit: u̱to sa mahya̱m indu̍bhi̱ḥ ṣaḍ yu̱ktām̐ a̍nu̱seṣi̍dhat | gobhi̱r yava̱ṁ na ca̍rkṛṣat ||
english: And he has closely tracked it for me with the Soma-drops, with six yoked ones, as if ploughing barley with cattle.

sanskrit: a̱mbayo̍ ya̱nty adhva̍bhir jā̱mayo̍ adhvarīya̱tām | pṛ̱ñca̱tīr madhu̍nā̱ paya̍ḥ ||
english: The mothers go along the sacrificial paths, the sisters of the ritual performers, mixing their milk with honey.

sanskrit: a̱mūr yā upa̱ sūrye̱ yābhi̍r vā̱ sūrya̍ḥ sa̱ha | tā no̍ hinvantv adhva̱ram ||
english: Those waters yonder that are beside the sun, and those with whom the sun goes — let them speed our sacrifice.

sanskrit: a̱po de̱vīr upa̍ hvaye̱ yatra̱ gāva̱ḥ piba̍nti naḥ | sindhu̍bhya̱ḥ kartva̍ṁ ha̱viḥ ||
english: I invoke the divine waters where our cattle drink; the oblation is to be made to the rivers.

sanskrit: a̱psv a1̱̍ntar a̱mṛta̍m a̱psu bhe̍ṣa̱jam a̱pām u̱ta praśa̍staye | devā̱ bhava̍ta vā̱jina̍ḥ ||
english: Within the waters is ambrosia, in the waters is medicine; for the praise of the waters, O gods, be endowed with vigor.

sanskrit: a̱psu me̱ somo̍ abravīd a̱ntar viśvā̍ni bheṣa̱jā | a̱gniṁ ca̍ vi̱śvaśa̍mbhuva̱m āpa̍ś ca vi̱śvabhe̍ṣajīḥ ||
english: Soma has told me that within the waters are all medicines, and Agni who is universally beneficent, and the waters who are universally healing.

sanskrit: āpa̍ḥ pṛṇī̱ta bhe̍ṣa̱jaṁ varū̍thaṁ ta̱nve̱3̱̍ mama̍ | jyok ca̱ sūrya̍ṁ dṛ̱śe ||
english: O Waters, provide medicine and protection for my body, that I may long see the sun.

sanskrit: i̱dam ā̍pa̱ḥ pra va̍hata̱ yat kiṁ ca̍ duri̱tam mayi̍ | yad vā̱ham a̍bhidu̱droha̱ yad vā̍ śe̱pa u̱tānṛ̍tam ||
english: O Waters, carry away from me whatever evil there is in me, whether I have committed treachery, or cursed, or spoken falsehood.

sanskrit: āpo̍ a̱dyānv a̍cāriṣa̱ṁ rase̍na̱ sam a̍gasmahi | paya̍svān agna̱ ā ga̍hi̱ tam mā̱ saṁ sṛ̍ja̱ varca̍sā ||
english: Today I have moved through the waters; we have merged with their essence. O Agni, come full of milk; unite me with vital radiance.

sanskrit: sam mā̍gne̱ varca̍sā sṛja̱ sam pra̱jayā̱ sam āyu̍ṣā | vi̱dyur me̍ asya de̱vā indro̍ vidyāt sa̱ha ṛṣi̍bhiḥ ||
english: O Agni, unite me with vital radiance, with offspring, with long life. May the gods know me for this; may Indra know it together with the seers.

sanskrit: kasya̍ nū̱naṁ ka̍ta̱masyā̱mṛtā̍nā̱m manā̍mahe̱ cāru̍ de̱vasya̱ nāma̍ | ko no̍ ma̱hyā adi̍taye̱ puna̍r dāt pi̱tara̍ṁ ca dṛ̱śeya̍m mā̱tara̍ṁ ca ||
english: Whose dear name among the immortals do we now celebrate? Who will give us back to great Aditi, so that I may see my father and my mother?

sanskrit: a̱gner va̱yam pra̍tha̱masyā̱mṛtā̍nā̱m manā̍mahe̱ cāru̍ de̱vasya̱ nāma̍ | sa no̍ ma̱hyā adi̍taye̱ puna̍r dāt pi̱tara̍ṁ ca dṛ̱śeya̍m mā̱tara̍ṁ ca ||
english: We celebrate the dear name of Agni, the first among the immortals. May he give us back to great Aditi, that I may see my father and my mother.

sanskrit: a̱bhi tvā̍ deva savita̱r īśā̍na̱ṁ vāryā̍ṇām | sadā̍van bhā̱gam ī̍mahe ||
english: O god Savitar, master of all desirable things, always beneficent one, we beg our share.

sanskrit: yaś ci̱d dhi ta̍ i̱tthā bhaga̍ḥ śaśamā̱naḥ pu̱rā ni̱daḥ | a̱dve̱ṣo hasta̍yor da̱dhe ||
english: For he who thus has diligently served you, Bhaga, is kept free from censure and without enmity in his hands.

sanskrit: bhaga̍bhaktasya te va̱yam ud a̍śema̱ tavāva̍sā | mū̱rdhāna̍ṁ rā̱ya ā̱rabhe̍ ||
english: We, who are partakers of your portion, Bhaga, would rise up through your aid; we take hold of the summit of wealth.

sanskrit: na̱hi te̍ kṣa̱traṁ na saho̱ na ma̱nyuṁ vaya̍ś ca̱nāmī pa̱taya̍nta ā̱puḥ | nemā āpo̍ animi̱ṣaṁ cara̍ntī̱r na ye vāta̍sya prami̱nanty abhva̍m ||
english: Not your dominion, nor your might, nor your anger — not even birds in flight have reached them. Not these unblinking, ever-flowing waters, nor those who do not diminish the force of the wind.

sanskrit: a̱bu̱dhne rājā̱ varu̍ṇo̱ vana̍syo̱rdhvaṁ stūpa̍ṁ dadate pū̱tada̍kṣaḥ ||  nī̱cīnā̍ḥ sthur u̱pari̍ bu̱dhna e̍ṣām a̱sme a̱ntar nihi̍tāḥ ke̱tava̍ḥ syuḥ ||
english: In the bottomless space, King Varuṇa of pure discernment holds up the crown of the tree upright; the rays are set downward, their roots are above; may their beams be implanted within us.

sanskrit: u̱ruṁ hi rājā̱ varu̍ṇaś ca̱kāra̱ sūryā̍ya̱ panthā̱m anve̍ta̱vā u̍ | a̱pade̱ pādā̱ prati̍dhātave 'kar u̱tāpa̍va̱ktā hṛ̍dayā̱vidha̍ś cit ||
english: King Varuṇa has made wide the path for the sun to travel; he has placed feet for the footless to walk by, and also removed the heart-piercers.

sanskrit: śa̱taṁ te̍ rājan bhi̱ṣaja̍ḥ sa̱hasra̍m u̱rvī ga̍bhī̱rā su̍ma̱tiṣ ṭe̍ astu | bādha̍sva dū̱re nirṛ̍tim parā̱caiḥ kṛ̱taṁ ci̱d ena̱ḥ pra mu̍mugdhy a̱smat ||
english: O King, you have a hundred healers, a thousand; wide and deep be your benevolence. Drive away Nirṛti far from us; release us even from the sin we have committed.

sanskrit: a̱mī ya ṛkṣā̱ nihi̍tāsa u̱ccā nakta̱ṁ dadṛ̍śre̱ kuha̍ ci̱d dive̍yuḥ | ada̍bdhāni̱ varu̍ṇasya vra̱tāni̍ vi̱cāka̍śac ca̱ndramā̱ nakta̍m eti ||
english: Those stars set on high — seen by night — where do they go in the daytime? The inviolable ordinances of Varuṇa are displayed as the moon travels by night.

sanskrit: tat tvā̍ yāmi̱ brahma̍ṇā̱ vanda̍māna̱s tad ā śā̍ste̱ yaja̍māno ha̱virbhi̍ḥ | ahe̍ḻamāno varuṇe̱ha bo̱dhy uru̍śaṁsa̱ mā na̱ āyu̱ḥ pra mo̍ṣīḥ ||
english: Praising you with sacred prayer I approach you; the sacrificer commissions you with oblations. Without offense, Varuṇa, be aware here; widely praised one, do not steal away our life.

sanskrit: tad in nakta̱ṁ tad divā̱ mahya̍m āhu̱s tad a̱yaṁ keto̍ hṛ̱da ā vi ca̍ṣṭe | śuna̱ḥśepo̱ yam ahva̍d gṛbhī̱taḥ so a̱smān rājā̱ varu̍ṇo mumoktu ||
english: That they say to me by night, that by day — this same message my heart discerns from within. He whom Śunaḥśepa called when bound — may that King Varuṇa release us.

sanskrit: śuna̱ḥśepo̱ hy ahva̍d gṛbhī̱tas tri̱ṣv ā̍di̱tyaṁ dru̍pa̱deṣu̍ ba̱ddhaḥ | avai̍na̱ṁ rājā̱ varu̍ṇaḥ sasṛjyād vi̱dvām̐ ada̍bdho̱ vi mu̍moktu̱ pāśā̍n ||
english: For Śunaḥśepa called out when seized, when bound to three posts, upon the son of Aditi. May King Varuṇa release him; knowing, undeceived, may he loose the bonds.

sanskrit: ava̍ te̱ heḻo̍ varuṇa̱ namo̍bhi̱r ava̍ ya̱jñebhi̍r īmahe ha̱virbhi̍ḥ | kṣaya̍nn a̱smabhya̍m asura pracetā̱ rāja̱nn enā̍ṁsi śiśrathaḥ kṛ̱tāni̍ ||
english: With obeisances we seek to remove your wrath, O Varuṇa; with sacrifices and oblations we implore. Ruling over us, O Asura of deep wisdom, O King, you loosen the sins we have committed.

sanskrit: ud u̍tta̱maṁ va̍ruṇa̱ pāśa̍m a̱smad avā̍dha̱maṁ vi ma̍dhya̱maṁ śra̍thāya | athā̍ va̱yam ā̍ditya vra̱te tavānā̍gaso̱ adi̍taye syāma ||
english: O Varuṇa, release from us the uppermost bond, loosen the lowermost and slacken the middle. Then, O son of Aditi, under your ordinance, may we be free of sin before Aditi.

sanskrit: yac ci̱d dhi te̱ viśo̍ yathā̱ pra de̍va varuṇa vra̱tam | mi̱nī̱masi̱ dyavi̍-dyavi ||
english: Whatever ordinance of yours, O god Varuṇa, we transgress day by day, as men do —

sanskrit: mā no̍ va̱dhāya̍ ha̱tnave̍ jihīḻā̱nasya̍ rīradhaḥ | mā hṛ̍ṇā̱nasya̍ ma̱nyave̍ ||
english: Do not deliver us, when you are provoked, to the blow of death; do not deliver us to the anger of the one who is angry.

sanskrit: vi mṛ̍ḻī̱kāya̍ te̱ mano̍ ra̱thīr aśva̱ṁ na saṁdi̍tam | gī̱rbhir va̍ruṇa sīmahi ||
english: We would stretch out your mind toward granting grace, as a charioteer pulls in a horse — O Varuṇa, with songs of praise.

sanskrit: parā̱ hi me̱ vima̍nyava̱ḥ pata̍nti̱ vasya̍ïṣṭaye | vayo̱ na va̍sa̱tīr upa̍ ||
english: For my errant longings fly away in search of wealth, like birds toward their nests.

sanskrit: ka̱dā kṣa̍tra̱śriya̱ṁ nara̱m ā varu̍ṇaṁ karāmahe | mṛ̱ḻī̱kāyo̍ru̱cakṣa̍sam ||
english: When shall we win Varuṇa the man of heroic glory, wide-seeing, who grants grace?

sanskrit: tad it sa̍mā̱nam ā̍śāte̱ vena̍ntā̱ na pra yu̍cchataḥ | dhṛ̱tavra̍tāya dā̱śuṣe̍ ||
english: Both of them seek the same thing, longing for it without failing — for the steadfast-vowed one, to the worshipper who offers.

sanskrit: vedā̱ yo vī̱nām pa̱dam a̱ntari̍kṣeṇa̱ pata̍tām | veda̍ nā̱vaḥ sa̍mu̱driya̍ḥ ||
english: He knows the track of birds flying through the atmosphere; he knows the course of the ships on the sea.

sanskrit: veda̍ mā̱so dhṛ̱tavra̍to̱ dvāda̍śa pra̱jāva̍taḥ | vedā̱ ya u̍pa̱jāya̍te ||
english: Varuṇa of steadfast ordinances knows the twelve months with their offspring; he knows what is born in addition.

sanskrit: veda̱ vāta̍sya varta̱nim u̱ror ṛ̱ṣvasya̍ bṛha̱taḥ | vedā̱ ye a̱dhyāsa̍te ||
english: He knows the path of the wide, exalted, and great wind; he knows those who dwell on high.

sanskrit: ni ṣa̍sāda dhṛ̱tavra̍to̱ varu̍ṇaḥ pa̱styā̱3̱̍sv ā | sāmrā̍jyāya su̱kratu̍ḥ ||
english: Varuṇa of steadfast ordinances, the wise-minded one, has taken his seat in the dwellings for sovereign kingship.

sanskrit: ato̱ viśvā̱ny adbhu̍tā ciki̱tvām̐ a̱bhi pa̍śyati | kṛ̱tāni̱ yā ca̱ kartvā̍ ||
english: From there, all-knowing, he looks down upon all marvels — what has been done and what is to be done.

sanskrit: sa no̍ vi̱śvāhā̍ su̱kratu̍r ādi̱tyaḥ su̱pathā̍ karat | pra ṇa̱ āyū̍ṁṣi tāriṣat ||
english: May the wise-minded Āditya set us on good paths every day; may he prolong our lives.

sanskrit: bibhra̍d drā̱piṁ hi̍ra̱ṇyaya̱ṁ varu̍ṇo vasta ni̱rṇija̍m | pari̱ spaśo̱ ni ṣe̍dire ||
english: Varuṇa wears a golden cloak and a shining garment; his spies have settled all around.

sanskrit: na yaṁ dipsa̍nti di̱psavo̱ na druhvā̍ṇo̱ janā̍nām | na de̱vam a̱bhimā̍tayaḥ ||
english: The deceivers do not deceive him; those who injure people, and the demons who assail him, cannot harm that god.

sanskrit: u̱ta yo mānu̍ṣe̱ṣv ā yaśa̍ś ca̱kre asā̱my ā | a̱smāka̍m u̱dare̱ṣv ā ||
english: And whoever among men has spread his fame without limit — even within our midst.

sanskrit: parā̍ me yanti dhī̱tayo̱ gāvo̱ na gavyū̍tī̱r anu̍ | i̱cchantī̍r uru̱cakṣa̍sam ||
english: My thoughts go forth seeking him, like cattle following the pasture path, seeking the wide-seeing one.

sanskrit: saṁ nu vo̍cāvahai̱ puna̱r yato̍ me̱ madhv ābhṛ̍tam | hote̍va̱ kṣada̍se pri̱yam ||
english: Let us speak together again, from whom honey has been brought for me; you enjoy the dear offering, like a priest at the rite.

sanskrit: darśa̱ṁ nu vi̱śvada̍rśata̱ṁ darśa̱ṁ ratha̱m adhi̱ kṣami̍ | e̱tā ju̍ṣata me̱ gira̍ḥ ||
english: Now let me behold the one visible to all, behold the chariot upon the earth; let these my songs find favor.

sanskrit: i̱mam me̍ varuṇa śrudhī̱ hava̍m a̱dyā ca̍ mṛḻaya | tvām a̍va̱syur ā ca̍ke ||
english: Hear this my call, O Varuṇa, and be gracious to me today; I come to you desiring your help.

sanskrit: tvaṁ viśva̍sya medhira di̱vaś ca̱ gmaś ca̍ rājasi | sa yāma̍ni̱ prati̍ śrudhi ||
english: You, the wise, reign over all of heaven and earth; hear me in your course of travel.

sanskrit: ud u̍tta̱mam mu̍mugdhi no̱ vi pāśa̍m madhya̱maṁ cṛ̍ta | avā̍dha̱māni̍ jī̱vase̍ ||
english: Release the uppermost bond from us, loosen the middle one; unloose the lowest ones, that we may live.

sanskrit: vasi̍ṣvā̱ hi mi̍yedhya̱ vastrā̍ṇy ūrjām pate | semaṁ no̍ adhva̱raṁ ya̍ja ||
english: Put on the sacrificial garments, O Lord of food and strength, and perform this sacrifice of ours.

sanskrit: ni no̱ hotā̍ vare̍ṇya̱ḥ sadā̍ yaviṣṭha̱ manma̍bhiḥ | agne̍ di̱vitma̍tā̱ vaca̍ḥ ||
english: Let the excellent Hotṛ-priest be seated for us always, youngest Agni, with our hymns — with speech that reaches heaven.

sanskrit: ā hi ṣmā̍ sū̱nave̍ pi̱tāpir yaja̍ty ā̱paye̍ | sakhā̱ sakhye̱ vare̍ṇyaḥ ||
english: For indeed the father sacrifices as a friend for his son, and for his family — a worthy friend to the friend.

sanskrit: ā no̍ ba̱rhī ri̱śāda̍so̱ varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā | sīda̍ntu̱ manu̍ṣo yathā ||
english: Let Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman — devourers of the wicked — take their seats on our sacred grass, as befits Manu's descendants.

sanskrit: pūrvya̍ hotar a̱sya no̱ manda̍sva sa̱khyasya̍ ca | i̱mā u̱ ṣu śru̍dhī̱ gira̍ḥ ||
english: O primal Hotṛ, rejoice in this rite of ours and in our friendship; hear well now these our songs.

sanskrit: yac ci̱d dhi śaśva̍tā̱ tanā̍ de̱vaṁ-de̍va̱ṁ yajā̍mahe | tve id dhū̍yate ha̱viḥ ||
english: However unceasingly we sacrifice to each god in turn, the oblation is indeed poured into you, O Agni.

sanskrit: pri̱yo no̍ astu vi̱śpati̱r hotā̍ ma̱ndro vare̍ṇyaḥ | pri̱yāḥ sva̱gnayo̍ va̱yam ||
english: May the lord of the clan, the joyful and excellent Hotṛ, be dear to us; may we who tend Agni well be dear to him.

sanskrit: sva̱gnayo̱ hi vārya̍ṁ de̱vāso̍ dadhi̱re ca̍ naḥ | sva̱gnayo̍ manāmahe ||
english: For the gods have given us desirable boons because we tend Agni well; as tenders of Agni we take thought.

sanskrit: athā̍ na u̱bhaye̍ṣā̱m amṛ̍ta̱ martyā̍nām | mi̱thaḥ sa̍ntu̱ praśa̍stayaḥ ||
english: And so, O immortal one, let there be mutual praises between us mortals and you — between both parties.

sanskrit: viśve̍bhir agne a̱gnibhi̍r i̱maṁ ya̱jñam i̱daṁ vaca̍ḥ | cano̍ dhāḥ sahaso yaho ||
english: O Agni, with all the fires, sustain this sacrifice and this speech; O son of strength, bestow delight.

sanskrit: aśva̱ṁ na tvā̱ vāra̍vantaṁ va̱ndadhyā̍ a̱gniṁ namo̍bhiḥ | sa̱mrāja̍ntam adhva̱rāṇā̍m ||
english: We would praise you, O Agni, with reverences, as a horse adorned with a mane — sovereign king of all sacrificial rites.

sanskrit: sa ghā̍ naḥ sū̱nuḥ śava̍sā pṛ̱thupra̍gāmā su̱śeva̍ḥ | mī̱ḍhvām̐ a̱smāka̍m babhūyāt ||
english: May he — the son who goes forth broadly with strength, most beneficent — become our bountiful one, showering gifts.

sanskrit: sa no̍ dū̱rāc cā̱sāc ca̱ ni martyā̍d aghā̱yoḥ | pā̱hi sada̱m id vi̱śvāyu̍ḥ ||
english: May he protect us always, he who lives for all — from the mortal who would harm us from near and from far.

sanskrit: i̱mam ū̱ ṣu tvam a̱smāka̍ṁ sa̱niṁ gā̍ya̱traṁ navyā̍ṁsam | agne̍ de̱veṣu̱ pra vo̍caḥ ||
english: Now do announce this prize-song of ours, this newest Gāyatra hymn, O Agni, among the gods.

sanskrit: ā no̍ bhaja para̱meṣv ā vāje̍ṣu madhya̱meṣu̍ | śikṣā̱ vasvo̱ anta̍masya ||
english: Grant us a share in the highest prizes, in the middle prizes; let us win a share of the innermost wealth.

sanskrit: vi̱bha̱ktāsi̍ citrabhāno̱ sindho̍r ū̱rmā u̍pā̱ka ā | sa̱dyo dā̱śuṣe̍ kṣarasi ||
english: You are the distributor, O brilliant-shining one, near at hand like the wave of a river; you flow immediately to the worshipper.

sanskrit: yam a̍gne pṛ̱tsu martya̱m avā̱ vāje̍ṣu̱ yaṁ ju̱nāḥ | sa yantā̱ śaśva̍tī̱r iṣa̍ḥ ||
english: The mortal whom you aid in battles, O Agni, whom you speed in contests — he becomes the perpetual ruler of refreshments.

sanskrit: naki̍r asya sahantya parye̱tā kaya̍sya cit | vājo̍ asti śra̱vāyya̍ḥ ||
english: No one at all can overcome his prize — none can encompass it from any side; his vigor is worthy of fame.

sanskrit: sa vāja̍ṁ vi̱śvaca̍rṣaṇi̱r arva̍dbhir astu̱ taru̍tā | vipre̍bhir astu̱ sani̍tā ||
english: May he, the all-pervading one, be the winner of the prize with swift steeds; may he be the winner of it with inspired singers.

sanskrit: jarā̍bodha̱ tad vi̍viḍḍhi vi̱śe-vi̍śe ya̱jñiyā̍ya | stoma̍ṁ ru̱drāya̱ dṛśī̍kam ||
english: O Agni, awakened by the elder's praise, kindle that visible hymn of praise to Rudra, fitting for each people at the sacrifice.

sanskrit: sa no̍ ma̱hām̐ a̍nimā̱no dhū̱make̍tuḥ puruśca̱ndraḥ | dhi̱ye vājā̍ya hinvatu ||
english: May the great, blameless, smoke-bannered, many-radiant one impel us toward wisdom and prize.

sanskrit: sa re̱vām̐ i̍va vi̱śpati̱r daivya̍ḥ ke̱tuḥ śṛ̍ṇotu naḥ | u̱kthair a̱gnir bṛ̱hadbhā̍nuḥ ||
english: Like a wealthy lord of the clan, the divine banner, great-rayed Agni — let him hear us with our hymns.

sanskrit: namo̍ ma̱hadbhyo̱ namo̍ arbha̱kebhyo̱ namo̱ yuva̍bhyo̱ nama̍ āśi̱nebhya̍ḥ | yajā̍ma de̱vān yadi̍ śa̱knavā̍ma̱ mā jyāya̍sa̱ḥ śaṁsa̱m ā vṛ̍kṣi devāḥ ||
english: Homage to the great, homage to the small, homage to the young, and homage to the old. We sacrifice to the gods if we are able; O gods, do not cut us off from the praise of the greater one.

sanskrit: yatra̱ grāvā̍ pṛ̱thubu̍dhna ū̱rdhvo bhava̍ti̱ sota̍ve | u̱lūkha̍lasutānā̱m aved v i̍ndra jalgulaḥ ||
english: Where the broad-based pressing-stone stands upright for pressing — Indra's gaping throat knows well of those who press in the mortar.

sanskrit: yatra̱ dvāv i̍va ja̱ghanā̍dhiṣava̱ṇyā̍ kṛ̱tā | u̱lūkha̍lasutānā̱m aved v i̍ndra jalgulaḥ ||
english: Where the two pressing boards are made, set up like two thighs — Indra's gaping throat knows well of those who press in the mortar.

sanskrit: yatra̱ nāry a̍pacya̱vam u̍pacya̱vaṁ ca̱ śikṣa̍te | u̱lūkha̍lasutānā̱m aved v i̍ndra jalgulaḥ ||
english: Where a woman learns to rock the mortar back and forth — Indra's gaping throat knows well of those who press in the mortar.

sanskrit: yatra̱ manthā̍ṁ viba̱dhnate̍ ra̱śmīn yami̍ta̱vā i̍va | u̱lūkha̍lasutānā̱m aved v i̍ndra jalgulaḥ ||
english: Where they fasten the churning stick with cords as if to rein in horses — Indra's gaping throat knows well of those who press in the mortar.

sanskrit: yac ci̱d dhi tvaṁ gṛ̱he-gṛ̍ha̱ ulū̍khalaka yu̱jyase̍ | i̱ha dyu̱matta̍maṁ vada̱ jaya̍tām iva dundu̱bhiḥ ||
english: O little mortar, however you are employed in house after house, here sound out the most brilliant noise, like the battle-drum of conquerors.

sanskrit: u̱ta sma̍ te vanaspate̱ vāto̱ vi vā̱ty agra̱m it | atho̱ indrā̍ya̱ pāta̍ve su̱nu soma̍m ulūkhala ||
english: And the wind blows across your front, O lord of the wood; therefore, mortar, press out the Soma for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: ā̱ya̱jī vā̍ja̱sāta̍mā̱ tā hy u1̱̍ccā vi̍jarbhṛ̱taḥ | harī̍ i̱vāndhā̍ṁsi̱ bapsa̍tā ||
english: The two most devoted to sacrifice and winning prizes — they resound aloft, like Indra's two bay steeds devouring the oblations.

sanskrit: tā no̍ a̱dya va̍naspatī ṛ̱ṣvāv ṛ̱ṣvebhi̍ḥ so̱tṛbhi̍ḥ | indrā̍ya̱ madhu̍mat sutam ||
english: Today may those two lordly ones of the forest, with exalted pressers, press out the honey-sweet Soma for Indra.

sanskrit: uc chi̱ṣṭaṁ ca̱mvo̍r bhara̱ soma̍m pa̱vitra̱ ā sṛ̍ja | ni dhe̍hi̱ gor adhi̍ tva̱ci ||
english: Bring the remnant from the two bowls; pour the Soma through the filter; lay it down upon the cow-hide.

sanskrit: yac ci̱d dhi sa̍tya somapā anāśa̱stā i̍va̱ smasi̍ | ā tū na̍ indra śaṁsaya̱ goṣv aśve̍ṣu śu̱bhriṣu̍ sa̱hasre̍ṣu tuvīmagha ||
english: Though we seem, O true Soma-drinker, like men without praise — do bring us fame, O Indra, in cattle, in bright horses, in thousands, O greatly bountiful one.

sanskrit: śipri̍n vājānām pate̱ śacī̍va̱s tava̍ da̱ṁsanā̍ | ā tū na̍ indra śaṁsaya̱ goṣv aśve̍ṣu śu̱bhriṣu̍ sa̱hasre̍ṣu tuvīmagha ||
english: O cheek-flanged lord of prizes, O Śacī-powered one, great are your wondrous deeds — do bring us fame, O Indra, in cattle, in bright horses, in thousands, O greatly bountiful one.

sanskrit: ni ṣvā̍payā mithū̱dṛśā̍ sa̱stām abu̍dhyamāne | ā tū na̍ indra śaṁsaya̱ goṣv aśve̍ṣu śu̱bhriṣu̍ sa̱hasre̍ṣu tuvīmagha ||
english: Lull to sleep those two, gazing in opposite directions, who lie not waking — do bring us fame, O Indra, in cattle, in bright horses, in thousands, O greatly bountiful one.

sanskrit: sa̱santu̱ tyā arā̍tayo̱ bodha̍ntu śūra rā̱taya̍ḥ | ā tū na̍ indra śaṁsaya̱ goṣv aśve̍ṣu śu̱bhriṣu̍ sa̱hasre̍ṣu tuvīmagha ||
english: Let those hostile ones sleep, let the generous gifts awake, O hero — do bring us fame, O Indra, in cattle, in bright horses, in thousands, O greatly bountiful one.

sanskrit: sam i̍ndra garda̱bham mṛ̍ṇa nu̱vanta̍m pā̱payā̍mu̱yā | ā tū na̍ indra śaṁsaya̱ goṣv aśve̍ṣu śu̱bhriṣu̍ sa̱hasre̍ṣu tuvīmagha ||
english: O Indra, crush together the braying donkey with that wicked device — do bring us fame, O Indra, in cattle, in bright horses, in thousands, O greatly bountiful one.

sanskrit: patā̍ti kuṇḍṛ̱ṇācyā̍ dū̱raṁ vāto̱ vanā̱d adhi̍ | ā tū na̍ indra śaṁsaya̱ goṣv aśve̍ṣu śu̱bhriṣu̍ sa̱hasre̍ṣu tuvīmagha ||
english: The Kuṇḍṛṇā bird flies far away above the forest on the wind — do bring us fame, O Indra, in cattle, in bright horses, in thousands, O greatly bountiful one.

sanskrit: sarva̍m parikro̱śaṁ ja̍hi ja̱mbhayā̍ kṛkadā̱śva̍m | ā tū na̍ indra śaṁsaya̱ goṣv aśve̍ṣu śu̱bhriṣu̍ sa̱hasre̍ṣu tuvīmagha ||
english: Slay with your jaws all-encompassing clamor and the Kṛkadāśva — do bring us fame, O Indra, in cattle, in bright horses, in thousands, O greatly bountiful one.

sanskrit: ā va̱ indra̱ṁ krivi̍ṁ yathā vāja̱yanta̍ḥ śa̱takra̍tum | maṁhi̍ṣṭhaṁ siñca̱ indu̍bhiḥ ||
english: Seeking the prize, pour for him who has a hundred powers, great Indra, with the Soma drops — pour for the most bountiful one, as for a Kṛvi.

sanskrit: śa̱taṁ vā̱ yaḥ śucī̍nāṁ sa̱hasra̍ṁ vā̱ samā̍śirām | ed u̍ ni̱mnaṁ na rī̍yate ||
english: Whether a hundred of the pure ones or a thousand of the mixed ones — still it flows down like water to the hollow.

sanskrit: saṁ yan madā̍ya śu̱ṣmiṇa̍ e̱nā hy a̍syo̱dare̍ | sa̱mu̱dro na vyaco̍ da̱dhe ||
english: When the potent one is gathered for intoxication — for it is within his belly — it spreads out like an ocean in the expanse.

sanskrit: a̱yam u̍ te̱ sam a̍tasi ka̱pota̍ iva garbha̱dhim | vaca̱s tac ci̍n na ohase ||
english: This Soma too has sped to you like a pigeon to its nest; yet you do not heed even that speech.

sanskrit: sto̱traṁ rā̍dhānām pate̱ girvā̍ho vīra̱ yasya̍ te | vibhū̍tir astu sū̱nṛtā̍ ||
english: May the praise of the lord of bounties, you O hero who carry hymns, whose abundance is real and joyful, be proclaimed.

sanskrit: ū̱rdhvas ti̍ṣṭhā na ū̱taye̱ 'smin vāje̍ śatakrato | sam a̱nyeṣu̍ bravāvahai ||
english: Stand upright for our aid in this prize-contest, O you of a hundred powers; let us speak together about the others too.

sanskrit: yoge̍-yoge ta̱vasta̍ra̱ṁ vāje̍-vāje havāmahe | sakhā̍ya̱ indra̍m ū̱taye̍ ||
english: In each and every yoking, in each and every prize-race, as friends we invoke Indra for our aid, the ever more powerful one.

sanskrit: ā ghā̍ gama̱d yadi̱ śrava̍t saha̱sriṇī̍bhir ū̱tibhi̍ḥ | vāje̍bhi̱r upa̍ no̱ hava̍m ||
english: Surely he will come if he hears — with his thousandfold aids and prizes — to our call.

sanskrit: anu̍ pra̱tnasyauka̍so hu̱ve tu̍vipra̱tiṁ nara̍m | yaṁ te̱ pūrva̍m pi̱tā hu̱ve ||
english: In the track of the ancient house I invoke the man of great counter-thrust, whom your father previously invoked.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̍ va̱yaṁ vi̍śvavā̱rā śā̍smahe puruhūta | sakhe̍ vaso jari̱tṛbhya̍ḥ ||
english: You who are all-desirable, O much-invoked one, we beseech you — O friend and lord, bestow on the singers.

sanskrit: a̱smāka̍ṁ śi̱priṇī̍nā̱ṁ soma̍pāḥ soma̱pāvnā̍m | sakhe̍ vajri̱n sakhī̍nām ||
english: O Soma-drinker, friend of those who drink Soma, O wielder of the thunderbolt, be the friend of our cheek-flanged warriors.

sanskrit: tathā̱ tad a̍stu somapā̱ḥ sakhe̍ vajri̱n tathā̍ kṛṇu | yathā̍ ta u̱śmasī̱ṣṭaye̍ ||
english: Let it be so, O Soma-drinker, O friend with the thunderbolt, make it so — as we desire for your favor.

sanskrit: re̱vatī̍r naḥ sadha̱māda̱ indre̍ santu tu̱vivā̍jāḥ | kṣu̱manto̱ yābhi̱r made̍ma ||
english: May our companions in joy at Indra's feast be rich and full of many prizes, the sustaining ones with which we would exult.

sanskrit: ā gha̱ tvāvā̱n tmanā̱ptaḥ sto̱tṛbhyo̍ dhṛṣṇav iyā̱naḥ | ṛ̱ṇor akṣa̱ṁ na ca̱kryo̍ḥ ||
english: Truly one such as you, self-achieved, proceeding boldly to the singers, unlocks the wheel-axle as it were from its wheels.

sanskrit: ā yad duva̍ḥ śatakrata̱v ā kāma̍ṁ jaritṝ̱ṇām | ṛ̱ṇor akṣa̱ṁ na śacī̍bhiḥ ||
english: When, O you of a hundred powers, you fulfill the desire of the singers, you loosen the wheel-axle with your deeds of might.

sanskrit: śaśva̱d indra̱ḥ popru̍thadbhir jigāya̱ nāna̍dadbhi̱ḥ śāśva̍sadbhi̱r dhanā̍ni | sa no̍ hiraṇyara̱thaṁ da̱ṁsanā̍vā̱n sa na̍ḥ sani̱tā sa̱naye̱ sa no̍ 'dāt ||
english: Indra has ever conquered wealth with snorting, roaring, triumphant steeds. May he, the wonder-working one with the golden chariot, be our winner and give to us.

sanskrit: āśvi̍nā̱v aśvā̍vatye̱ṣā yā̍ta̱ṁ śavī̍rayā | goma̍d dasrā̱ hira̍ṇyavat ||
english: O Aśvins, come on this horse-rich path with your mighty power; come, O wondrous ones, with cattle and with gold.

sanskrit: sa̱mā̱nayo̍jano̱ hi vā̱ṁ ratho̍ dasrā̱v ama̍rtyaḥ | sa̱mu̱dre a̍śvi̱neya̍te ||
english: For your chariot, O wondrous immortal Aśvins, is yoked by the same yoking; it courses over the sea.

sanskrit: ny a1̱̍ghnyasya̍ mū̱rdhani̍ ca̱kraṁ ratha̍sya yemathuḥ | pari̱ dyām a̱nyad ī̍yate ||
english: You have set the wheel of your chariot upon the head of the inviolable cow; the other one revolves around the sky.

sanskrit: kas ta̍ uṣaḥ kadhapriye bhu̱je marto̍ amartye | kaṁ na̍kṣase vibhāvari ||
english: Who of the mortals enjoys you, O Uṣas, O beloved of Kadhapri, O immortal one? Whom do you seek, O you of many lights?

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ hi te̱ ama̍nma̱hy āntā̱d ā pa̍rā̱kāt | aśve̱ na ci̍tre aruṣi ||
english: For we have pondered you, O ruddy one bright as a horse, from near and from far away.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tyebhi̱r ā ga̍hi̱ vāje̍bhir duhitar divaḥ | a̱sme ra̱yiṁ ni dhā̍raya ||
english: Come with those prizes, O daughter of heaven; bestow wealth upon us.
